title: Parse minutes into a result
prompt: Parsed is supplied. Write public static Parsed ParseMinutes(string text). When text is a whole number of 0 or more, return Parsed with Ok true, that number, and an empty Error. When text is not a number, return Ok false, 0 and the Error "not a number". When it is a negative number, return Ok false, 0 and the Error "negative". The method must not throw for any of these.
hints: There are three outcomes. Which one does int.Parse report by throwing?
Handle text that is not a number first, then look at the number you got.
Catch FormatException around int.Parse, or use int.TryParse, and return the matching Parsed in each case.
checkLabels: "0" is a valid number and must give Ok true with 0.
"soon" must give Ok false with the error "not a number".
Empty text must give Ok false with the error "not a number".
"-5" must give Ok false with the error "negative".

wrongAnswers.misconception: Never checks the number after parsing it.

feedback: Go through the three outcomes with the failing text. Check which one your code picks and that all three values of the result match the prompt.
